kind: bounded retained CIL instruction replay and independent numeric composition
limits: No original DLL method or GUI executed.
Source interpreter is reused in memory from the frozen prior probe; its test/output section is never evaluated and no prior file is written.

Factory constructor and point/rectangle storage are explicit sinks; setter/getter, angle special-case dispatch, trig calculation, scalar thresholds, hN4K leading dispatch and numeric primitives execute retained instructions.
Final coordinates independently compose retained hN4K/iN4x formulae; full collection/reindex pipeline and callbacks are not executed.

Inputs here are supplied effective rotation values to SizingRect. General Transform/cache provider precedence, nonfinite values, upstream author angle canonicalization and original GUI pixels are outside coverage.
